test_anthropic_tool_result_fix: test the fix that ensures tool_calls are added to assistant messages when tool_results are present but tool_calls are missing
cache_tool_call_definition: cache a tool call definition using TOOL_CALLS_CACHE so it can be retrieved when reconstructing messages from spend logs
ensure_tool_results_have_tool_calls: ensure tool results have corresponding tool calls by calling _ensure_tool_results_have_corresponding_tool_calls on messages with missing tool_calls
transform_request_to_anthropic_format: transform OpenAI-style messages and tools into Anthropic API format using AnthropicConfig transform_request
verify_anthropic_tool_use_blocks: verify that an Anthropic assistant message contains tool_use blocks with the correct tool call ID after transformation
